questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

5 ∶ 31 ∶∶ 7 ∶ ? ∶ 9 ∶ 87
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (First number)² + 6 = Second number.**

1) 5 : 31

⇒ (5)² + 6 = 25 + 6 = **31**

And,

2) 9 : 87

⇒ (9)² + 6 = 81 + 6 = **87**

Similarly,

3) 7 : ?

⇒ (7)² + 6 = 49 + 6 = **55**

Hence, the correct answer is **"55".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All chains are taps.

All taps are plastic.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some plastic are taps.

II. Some plastic are chains.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33a752dbc3e0acfa5030602a74f0771c9f8c51cf21433749b58978c05d6a4046.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some plastic are taps → Follow (As all chains are taps and all taps are plastic so, some plastic are taps is definite true)

II. Some plastic are chains → Follow (As all chains are taps and all taps are plastic so, some plastic are chains are definite true)

Hence, the correct answer is "Both conclusions I and II follow".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Only conclusions I and II follow.

**Statements:**

Some species are fishes.

All fishes are frogs.

No frog is a turtle.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some frogs are fishes.

II. Some species are frogs.

III. Some fishes are turtles.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca5597bec8f67c5a1983b5d9f4a74ecc51da1107c43d1e64aa27fd72b5df876.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some frogs are fishes → Follow (As all fishes are frogs so, some frogs are fishes is definite true)

II. Some species are frogs → Follow (As all fishes are frogs and some species are fishes so, some species are frogs is definite true)

III. Some fishes are turtles → Does not Follow (As no frogs are turtle and all fishes are frogs so some fishes are turtles is definite not follow)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions I and II follows".

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

First term × 1 = Second term; First term × 2 = Third term, and so on. 

27 × 1 = 27

27 × 2 = 54

27 × 3 = 81

27 × 4 = 108

Hence, the correct answer is **"108".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers (not digits) need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

​15 × 6 + 25 - 30 ÷ 5 = 95
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule:-**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Option 1) 25 and 6

After interchange the numbers we get:

⇒ 15 × 25 + 6 - __**30 ÷ 5**__ = 95

⇒ __**15 × 25**__ + 6 - 6 = 95

⇒ __**375 + 6 **__- 6 = 95

⇒ __**381 - 6 **__= 95

⇒ 375 ≠ 95

questions.solution:
